cards.client: Prepared for a global IT services provider (named only in the filename); body is the generic mid-2026 all-products storyline
cards.client_actual: TCS (filename only); the largest-customers slide lists anonymised install-base descriptors
cards.key_problem: AI models now find and chain software vulnerabilities faster than any patch cycle, legacy and open-source components widen the attack surface, and a multi-vendor hybrid-work stack adds cost, integration gaps and inconsistent policy.
key_outcomes: Threat opening (slides 2-6): Claude Mythos-style AI vulnerability discovery (27-year-old OpenBSD bug, 16-year-old FFmpeg bug, chained Linux privilege escalation); 86% of codebases carry vulnerable open-source, 81% of those high/critical, 5-15% of dependencies end-of-life, 218 new CVEs per EOL component every 6 months; ten AI-era threat types; public-website breach diagram

Positioning (slides 8-11): 'isolate your crown jewels, reduce the threat vector, validate every access'; a map of where ZTNA, SSE, enterprise browser, IAM, VDI and UEM each fit; vendor-sprawl vs single-vendor benefits

Company (slides 12-13): 1000+ enterprise customers, 200+ partners, 350+ team, 2M+ users, part of Reliance since Sep 2023; About slide says '2023 & 2024 Gartner MQ' while slide 13 says recognised in the 2025 DaaS MQ

Largest customers slide (24): VDI & ZTNA for 10,000 and MFA for 90,000 at the 3rd largest private bank, RBI for BYOD 350,000 users, clientless ZTNA with MFA 500,000 users for the Indian federal government IT division, VDI for 100,000 users

Identity (slides 25-27): 150+ apps per organisation, only 1 in 3 SSO-ready, $250,000/year lost to logins for 10,000 users; HyID six factors plus SSO for SAML, AD/LDAP and native apps via password vault

Product slides: HySecure on-prem and ZTNA-as-a-service (sovereign cloud logs, DC-DR, 99.99% uptime), Accops + Forcepoint SSE, Digital Workspace VDI on any hypervisor, HyDesk HY1000/4000/6000 spec table, remote browser isolation for internet and for critical apps, GlassFence

Offers (slides 28, 33, 40): JAS-quarter free SSO for legacy apps for 6 months and 50% discount for FY27 orders; free VDI licences until the existing VDI contract expires; DaaS including endpoint at Rs 1,333/user/month

Credentials (slides 10-18): 1000+ customers, 350+ team; JioPC 1.6 million users; 'Two consecutive years in the Gartner MQ for DaaS 2026 & 2025' (slide 14) while slide 10 still says 2023 & 2024; awards slide 2023-2025 (DSCI, GEC, FWS, Nasscom, GCC, GATES); largest-customers slide

DPDP Act slide (30): timeline (assent Aug 2023, rules Nov 2025, full compliance 13 May 2027), six principles, 72-hour breach notice, penalties up to Rs 250 crore

VDI (slides 29-41): Windows 10 EOL, PC carbon footprint, VDI use cases, 5-year TCO for 2,000 users (VDI Rs 27.21 crore vs desktops Rs 31.20 crore, Rs 3.98 crore or 13% saving), free VDI licences until the incumbent contract expires, DaaS at Rs 1,333/user/month
